vectors.name: horizon-level-0: a group’s horizon is its deadline: Ana’s ballot a minute before it counts, so Riverside passes F’s motion and owes C its pass
horizon-level-0-at: a ballot received at the group’s deadline is ignored, so Riverside’s vote lapses and it owes C a fail

horizon-level-1-not-final: in C, a level-1 coalition, both seats pass a minute before its horizon, the deadline plus a day; a minute before that minute C’s pass is certain but not final, so C owes D nothing yet
horizon-level-1: at C’s horizon its pass is final, and C owes D its pass, a day before results stop counting in D
horizon-level-1-at: a result received at C’s horizon is ignored, so C counts B’s seat as missing and fails the motion there, and owes D that fail
horizon-level-2-not-final: C’s pass crosses at C’s horizon and E’s with it; a minute before D’s horizon, two days after the deadline, D’s pass is certain but not final, so D owes F nothing yet
horizon-level-2: at D’s horizon its pass is final, and D owes F its pass, a day before results stop counting in F
horizon-level-2-at: C’s pass received at D’s horizon is ignored, so D fails the motion there, and owes F that fail
horizon-level-3-not-final: D’s and G’s passes reach F; a minute before F’s horizon, three days after the deadline, F’s pass is certain but not final, and its text hasn’t changed
horizon-level-3: at F’s horizon its pass is final, and its text changes
horizon-level-3-at: D’s pass received at F’s horizon is ignored, so F fails the motion there and its text stays
forms-final-level-2-forming: D, a level-2 coalition with only C’s pass on its genesis, is still forming a minute before formsFinal, its genesis plus 14 days and two days
forms-final-level-2: still forming at formsFinal, D is declined there for both its seats, and E’s pass received in that minute is ignored

five-seats-certain: in C, a coalition of five seats, four pass, so C’s pass is certain; it isn’t final until C’s horizon, the deadline plus a day, so C owes D nothing, where before #387 its pass crossed up at once
five-seats-contested: a contest on L0 then leaves C open, not failed, and C still owes D nothing
five-seats: at C’s horizon, three passes of five fall short of two-thirds, so C’s final outcome is a fail, and C owes D that fail
five-seats-crossed: C’s fail crosses at its horizon, before D’s, so D fails what C failed, whenever C’s devices crossed
five-seats-forged-early: a holder of C’s seat secret posts a pass for C in D early; C owes no fail for it before its own outcome is final, as a group owes none
five-seats-forged-early-contested: C’s final fail crosses at its horizon, so C’s seat in D is contested, counts as a fail, and D fails the motion
recovery: after the contest, L4 passes, so four of five pass and C’s final outcome at its horizon is a pass; C owes D that pass
recovery-crossed: C’s pass crosses at its horizon, so D passes what C passed, where before #387 the fail for C’s withdrawn pass failed it
